meta.about: Decay chains followed through ENSDF decay modes (IAEA LiveChart of Nuclides); branches below 1e-05% omitted. af = activity relative to the chain parent in secular equilibrium. Coincidences: probability that another gamma of the same decay is emitted, from the level scheme.
meta.alpha_beta_source: alpha energies from NeuCBOT's ENSDF-derived lists; beta spectra not available in this build
